What MDM Date & Time policy actually covers — listing honesty

Apple supports MDM Date & Time policy through Configuration Profiles and related MDM restriction payloads where administrators configure system date, time, and time zone on enrolled Mac, iPhone, and iPad devices — including set date and time automatically, time server and NTP address, time zone selection and forced time zone, 24-hour time format, restrict user date-time changes, and related clock posture. macOS System Settings and iOS Settings surface Date & Time UI where users and admins review automatic sync, time server, time zone, and 24-hour toggles. Third-party MDM and UEM apps may complement this by surfacing Date & Time policy editors, clock-drift compliance dashboards, and date-time remediation workflows. Date & Time vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

MDM Date & Time marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate system clock policy:

日期与时间 (Date & Time)

Enterprise MDM marketing uses 日期与时间 alongside the English term Date & Time when describing MDM-configured system clock settings on enrolled fleet devices. AppLocale picks phrasing buyers recognize on each screenshot — a set-automatically toggle needs 日期与时间-friendly headlines; a technical badge may keep Date & Time when accurate to your English source.

自动设置日期与时间 (set date and time automatically)

When MDM workflows mirror macOS System Settings or iOS Settings Date & Time panes, zh-Hans enterprise docs use 自动设置日期与时间 and 自动设置. Use when your gallery shows "Set date and time automatically" or "Set automatically" toggles.

时间服务器 / NTP (time server / NTP)

When Date & Time payloads configure network time sync or custom NTP server addresses, use 时间服务器 and NTP on frames showing "Time server", "NTP server", or "Network time protocol" fields — distinct from consumer Clock app world-clock city lists.

时区 (time zone)

When Date & Time policy enforces or restricts time zone selection — including forced time zone on supervised devices — use 时区 on frames showing "Time zone", "Force time zone", or time zone picker controls.

24小时制 (24-hour time)

When Date & Time payloads enable or enforce 24-hour clock format fleet-wide, use 24小时制 on frames showing "24-hour time" toggles — distinct from Menu Bar clock display format unless your frame shows menu-bar settings specifically.

MDM 日期时间 (MDM Date & Time)

When MDM console workflows surface Date & Time policy editors or compliance dashboards, zh-Hans enterprise docs use MDM 日期时间. Use when your gallery shows "MDM Date & Time policy" overlays or fleet clock-sync compliance panels.
